chunks: Al-‘Alā’ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
“It is not appropriate for a man to reside in Makkah for a year.”
He عليه السلام said: “He should move away from it, and it is not appropriate that a building be raised above the Ka‘bah.”

key_terms.الْكَعْبَةِ: the Ka‘bah, the Sacred House in Makkah
key_terms.سَنَةً: a year; the period mentioned for residence
key_terms.لَا يَنْبَغِي: it is not appropriate; indicates disapproval or undesirability in context

ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to live in Makkah continuously for a full year, and can buildings be raised above the Ka‘bah?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a ruling of discouragement regarding prolonged residence in Makkah and states that one should relocate rather than remain there continuously for a full year. It also teaches the impropriety of constructing buildings higher than the Ka‘bah, emphasizing reverence for the sanctity and status of the Sacred House.
